assets.prompt:
Create ONE educational illustration, a separate cutout asset. Fine charcoal ink contours with restrained layered watercolour and realistic object/anatomy proportions. Match an editorial natural-history teaching collection. TRUE transparent alpha outside the object, no painted paper rectangle, no checkerboard. Keep roughly 12% clear transparent margins on every side. No people, human hands, human faces, brands or labels. Include text, numbers or arrows only if the individual asset brief explicitly requires them. Animal heads are essential where appropriate. Preserve the requested view and approximate aspect ratio. No cast shadow or floor unless explicitly requested. ASSET BRIEF: 1. `hms-then-now-desks-v1.png` (2400 x 1300): two teenagers' desks side by side against one plain wall, with a clear gap between them. Left desk (about 1995): a corded landline phone, a cassette player with headphones, a spiral paper diary, a printed street directory, a hardcover school yearbook, a folded newspaper and a photo frame turned so only its back shows. Right desk (today): a smartphone lying face down, a closed laptop, wireless earbuds in their case, a transport card, a reusable drink bottle, and the same style of photo frame turned the same way. Warm daylight on the left desk, cooler daylight on the right. No people, no screens showing content, no brand marks, no vapes, cigarettes or alcohol.

Hand-in to `status.md`; provenance `docs/production/claude-pm/assets/hms-y11-a06-provenance.json`.
